Read the movement signature of each inferred state

Source: R/state-display.R
ssf_state_summary.Rd

Counts describe decoded steps. Length means and SDs describe the intrinsic movement kernel, holding environmental terms constant. They are baseline summaries when lengths have hourly or lag effects. Stay probabilities are model estimates. A geometric mean run length is returned only for homogeneous multi-state transitions; it is not an observed bout length.

Usage

ssf_state_summary(
  x,
  step_scale = 1,
  step_unit = "input units",
  assessment = NULL
)

Arguments

x

A fitted ssf_fit or selected guided_ssf object.

step_scale

Positive multiplier applied to step lengths and their SDs. For input in kilometres, use 1000 to display metres.

step_unit

Label for the resulting distance unit. Units are not inferred.

assessment

Optional accepted assessment from assess_taxonomy() for this fitted model. This makes a post-fit ecological interpretation visible without fitting the model again.

Value

A data frame with state labels, decoded counts and fractions, fitted movement summaries, stay-probability ranges and expected run lengths in steps.
